_about: GX Cluster registry (schema 2) — the single source of truth for nodes, runtimes, model packs, public aliases, deployments (primary + rollback), logical modes, serving profiles and reasoning levels. Loader/validator: legenex/models/registry.py. D-053 (2026-10-16): DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 abliterated (vLLM, kit legenex/models/dsv4-flash) is the PRIMARY deployment; DeepSeek V4.1 EXL3 (Mia kit) is kept as the rollback. Which deployment is ACTIVE is runtime state (/srv/projects/gx-cluster/state/orchestrator/active-deployment.json, written only by the orchestrator's typed switch); with no switch on record it is initial_active_deployment. Supersedes the schema-1 alias table of the retired L-6/L-10 stack (git tag pre-deepseek-v41-rebuild-20260927).

fabric.notes: NCCL traffic uses BOTH ConnectX-7 rails (192.168.100.x / 192.168.101.x) with a PER-NIC GID index; the all-zero GID entry dies ~60 s into a run with ibv_modify_qp errno 61 (state/EVIDENCE.md). GID index 3 is the proven pin. Tailscale is management/SSH only and must never appear in a model or NCCL path.

mia-dsv41.notes: vLLM-based 2x DGX Spark EXL3 kit, TP=2, nnodes=2, master port 29521. OpenAI API on head :8888 (bound 0.0.0.0 by the kit; reached by the orchestrator on loopback). Lifecycle owned by the orchestrator, no boot autoload. Worker reads the weights over the kit's NFSv4 export from gx10-01 (WEIGHT_SYNC=nfs).

_aliases_note: Alias model/runtime bindings describe the LANDING state (the rollback deployment, still serving). The model actually behind every alias is the ACTIVE deployment's: /srv/projects/gx-cluster/state/orchestrator/active-deployment.json, else initial_active_deployment (Registry.active_model(), control-ui models.production_model_id). A typed switch moves all five aliases at once.
